instruction: The owner requested an audit across Navrang history and completion of the remaining work, including the follow-up Android release and website update.
deviceEvidence: The original-key-signed 0.9.2 APK upgraded published 0.9.1 in place on the dedicated Android API 37 emulator, retaining the app ID, app data directory and original install time. Both versions launched.
publicationInstruction: Publish Navrang 0.9.2 using the existing release channel and original signing identity.
